title: Catamaran Helm Steering Wheel Deck
description: stainless steel wheel, teak deck, a captain's chair angled toward wherever the wind decides to take us next. there's something almost meditative about the helm of a #USVI charter boat, all that quiet machinery waiting for someone to make a decision. i could stand here doing nothing for a very long time.
alt_text: Stainless steel steering wheel and white captain's chair on the teak deck of a catamaran near a waterfront resort

title: Cloudy Sky Over Turquoise Reef Water
description: storm clouds rolling in over water so turquoise it barely looks real, snorkel gear rolled up and waiting like it knows the weather might not cooperate. this is the #CaribbeanSea being unpredictable in the most beautiful way, one minute glowing green, the next bracing for rain. i've learned to love both moods equally.
alt_text: Dramatic cloudy sky over turquoise reef water with a yellow rolled up Aqua Lung snorkel mat on a boat railing

title: Woman Laughing at Catamaran Helm
description: she turned around laughing right as the shutter clicked, hand on the wheel, hills of #StThomas rolling out behind her in the distance. i think this might be my favorite kind of travel photo, the accidental ones, the moments nobody choreographed.
alt_text: Woman in a navy shirt and white visor laughing while standing at a catamaran helm with hills in the background

title: Family Sailing Trip Catamaran Helm
description: a whole group scattered across the deck, someone steering, someone holding the canopy up, a kid tucked into the corner soaking in the ride. #USVI sailing charters have this way of turning strangers and families into one loose, sunburned unit by the end of the day.
alt_text: Woman steering a catamaran while a man holds the canopy and a child sits nearby on the deck near St Thomas

title: Catamaran Deck Group Candid Moment
description: same scene, another second later, everyone still finding their footing on a moving boat. i love how candid photography on the water always ends up capturing genuine joy instead of anything posed, the #VirginIslands doing exactly what it does best.
alt_text: Group of people on a catamaran deck near St Thomas with a woman steering and hills visible across the water

title: Waterfront Hotel and Wildlife Hillside
description: the hotel rose up cream colored and quiet above a hillside that turned out to be full of movement once i looked closer, deer grazing right along the water's edge. #USVI wildlife shows up in the places you least expect it, right next to five star balconies and manicured hedges.
alt_text: White waterfront hotel building on a tropical hillside with deer visible grazing near the water below

title: Deer Grazing Near Beach Stairs USVI
description: white stairs leading down to the water, palm trees leaning in, and there, almost missable, a deer wandering along the hedge line like it owns the property. i never expected wildlife sightings to be part of a #VirginIslands hotel stay, but here we are.
alt_text: White wooden stairs and deck near a hillside with deer grazing among hedges above the water in the Virgin Islands

title: Single Deer on Tropical Hillside
description: just one deer this time, caught mid step against a hillside so green it almost swallows her whole. i keep thinking about how unexpected #USVI wildlife feels against all that resort polish, a reminder that the island was wild long before anyone built anything on it.
alt_text: A single deer grazing on a green tropical hillside near white stairs and palm trees by the water

title: Sleepy Dog on Catamaran at Marina
description: she draped herself across that cooler like gravity had personally requested it, one ear up, completely unbothered by the marina full of sailboats around her. dogs on boats in the #USVI always look like they've figured out something the rest of us haven't, mainly, how to fully relax.
alt_text: Tan and white dog sleeping stretched across a white cooler on a catamaran deck at a marina

title: Dog Sitting on Boat Cooler Marina
description: she perked up for this one, chin up, leash looped loosely beside her, marina masts crisscrossing the sky behind her. every #VirginIslands sailing trip needs a good boat dog, and this one clearly takes the job seriously.
alt_text: Tan and white dog sitting alert on a white cooler aboard a catamaran with sailboat masts visible at a marina
